scope: native extracted-helper fixture only; no production source change retained

method.source: Actual indexed readers/uploaders and cellGcm resolver extracted from production source; resolver and callers compiled as separate translation units.
method.timing: Windows QueryPerformanceCounter; five alternating 50 ms minimum blocks per path, hooks/counters disabled.
method.limits: Native microbenchmark only. No project build, game run, scene distribution, or FPS claim.

coverage: Primitive modes 1 through 10, restart disabled and enabled
Immediate, LOCAL u16/u32, and MAIN u16/u32 indices
Emitted topology, count, and vertex bytes compare equal
Live LOCAL index-byte mutation observed between fetches
MAIN mapping remap and unmap observed on each fetch

resolver_call_counts.meaning: Calls during uploader cases, including the unchanged vertex-attribute resolutions.

timing_runs_ns_per_index.run: final fixture run with call-count output

decision_reason: Local index lookup savings are about 0.66 to 1.25 ns per fetch in these runs, while the MAIN fallback adds measured per-fetch overhead and the game's LOCAL/MAIN mix is unknown. This evidence does not justify addressing the observed roughly 12 ms average shortfall or 300 ms hitches.
